title: team.constructor 1.0
description: teams::Constructor: a real Formula 1 team. The ids are the core's shared ids (constructor/<key>): a team.identity record lists the ids it provides, and team is the last enabled provider in load order (null when none).

team.description: Resolved by the core: the last enabled team.identity in load order whose provides lists this id.
